newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit seen pressured by fund buying of dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit seen pressured by fund buying of dollar.

text.p: * Ringgit pressured by dollar buying by hedge funds
* Dollar/ringgit seen in tight range trading
* Dollar rise expected to be capped by Bank Negara at 2.5250
The ringgit remained pressured by dollar buying by hedge funds but fears of Bank Negara's presence continued to cap the dollar's rise at 2.5250.
Dealers said they expected dollar/ringgit to trade in a very tight range on Tuesday.
"There has been a lot of buying of dollar by hedge funds but Negara is waiting at the 2.5250 level. It will be very tight today, maybe 2.5240-2.5250," said a dealer with a European bank in Singapore.
Apart from Bank Negara aggressively defending the ringgit at 2.5250, local corporates were also looking to sell the dollar at that level, dealers said.
Some dealers said the central bank could have sold up to $2 billion since last week to defend the ringgit.
At 0215 GMT, the ringgit was quoted at 2.5243/53 to a dollar. It closed at 2.5240/50 in Kuala Lumpur on Monday.
